description: Portfolio-wide release/completion ledger. Maps every suite v1 criterion to its governing recovery-program obligations and release blockers. Obligation-level truth stays authoritative in portfolio/recovery-program.json; this ledger only aggregates and adds the release-lifecycle axis.

criteria.name: every completed accessibility wave discharges its runtime-parity obligation
accessibility runtime converges to a canonical implementation
authentic source execution is retained for the running obligations
disposition obligations close with retained resolution evidence
remaining operator-os waves discharge runtime-parity obligations
every brand-publishing wave discharges its runtime-parity obligation
every production-house wave discharges its runtime-parity obligation
agent reliability runtime and disposition obligations discharge

global_blockers.name: release/completion ledger is implemented, valid, and registry-enforced
six v1 contracts and persistent state formats are frozen before authentic runtime integration
stable CLI/API control-plane surface is frozen
